description: This file defines a ServerRegistry class for managing browser descriptors, including listing, creating, deleting, and reading descriptors, as well as checking connectivity. It also exports a singleton instance of ServerRegistry.

classes.name: ServerRegistry
classes.description: A class that manages browser descriptors, including listing, creating, deleting, and reading descriptors, and checking connection status.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists all browser descriptors, returning a map keyed by workspace directory.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new browser descriptor and saves it to disk.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a browser descriptor file by GUID.

methods.name: deleteUserData
methods.description: Deletes user data directory associated with a browser descriptor.

methods.name: readDescriptor
methods.description: Reads and returns a browser descriptor by GUID.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds a browser descriptor by its title.

methods.name: _browsersDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path where browser descriptors are stored.
